Check the [roadmap](https://github.com/Troppy2/Gopher-Planner/blob/HEAD/docs/ROADMAP.md) and existing issues first. Open issue checklists can lag implementation.

## User problem

Who needs this, and what task is difficult today?

## Proposed behavior

Describe the smallest useful result and how a user would reach it.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Observable result:
- [ ] Failure/missing-data behavior:
- [ ] Verification with synthetic data:

## Sources and dependencies

For academic changes, identify the official source and catalog version. For external integrations, describe source permission, rate limits, provenance, and missing-data behavior. Do not include student records or secrets.
